title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v111
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add v111 profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a reporting pipeline integration for adaptive batching experiments. Backwards-compatible changes only.
description: This PR adds the benchmark-lab v111 release: updated profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state, a new set of representative workload runners (chat, longform generation, embeddings ramp), and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that aggregates profiling traces and percentile-based latency metrics into our analytics store. Motivation: recent infra changes (kernel selection and KV cache improvements) produced regressions for specific long-sequence workloads; we need a repeatable baseline and automated reporting to detect regressions in CI. Changes include new runner configs, updated profiling harness, export adapters for trace -> metrics conversion, dashboard provisioning templates, and a lightweight runner orchestrator to schedule profiling jobs. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baseline data and JSON schemas - [x] Implement representative workload runners and config templates - [x] Add reporting pipeline (pipeline + export adapters) - [x] Add unit and integration tests for harness and adapters - [x] Update CI to run reduced profiling suite on PRs that touch serving/runtime - [x] Document expected baselines and dashboard queries Notes: The description below contains implementation notes, operational guidance, and migration steps. No production breaking changes are included; dashboards are optional and behind a feature flag.
commits: Init v111 profiling baselines and schemas
Add representative workload runner configs (chat, longform, embeddings-ramp)
Implement trace->metrics export adapter for reporting pipeline
Orchestrator: lightweight scheduler for profiling jobs
Tests: unit tests for adapters and integration test for pipeline
Docs: dashboard templates and runbook updates
review_comments: Marco Hernandez: Left a couple of suggestions on the exporter regarding batching the metric writes. Also can we add a knob to limit exported trace size?
Aisha Patel: Addressed by adding max_trace_size in exporter config and batching logic with configurable batch_size. Added unit test for batching behavior.
Li Wei: Noted flakiness in the longform_runner integration test on p3-standard. Added a retry wrapper and lowered concurrency for CI runs.
Jordan Kim: Approved after confirming CI profile run passes and dashboards render correctly in staging. Minor nit to docs about expected baseline numbers.
CI Bot: profiling-ci failed on first run (timeout in orchestration test). Re-run successful after reducing concurrency.
notes_for_ops: Deploy pipeline v111 via infra playbook. Default feature flag for reporting is disabled; set REPORTING_V111=true to enable. Ensure storage bucket has lifecycle policy for profiling traces to avoid retention bloat.
how_to_verify: Run ci/profiling-runner.yml in staging; check that pipeline ingests traces and populates metrics index. Validate dashboard v111 in Grafana and confirm baseline percentiles match files in benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v111.
mitigation: Run reduced profiling suite in PRs touching serving/runtime; alerts configured to block merges if 95th percentile regresses beyond threshold.
